results.title: 🇻🇳A Canal of Discord Vietnam Assesses New Risks A major infrastructure project has the potential to alter not only trade routes but also rel
results.description:
🇻🇳A Canal of Discord
Vietnam Assesses New Risks

A major infrastructure project has the potential to alter not only trade routes but also relations with neighboring states - especially when the economic calculations appear to mask the geopolitical interests of a third party.

In Cambodia, construction of the Funan Techo Canal is gradually moving forward. This new 180-kilometer-long shipping route will provide a direct link between the capital, Phnom Penh, and the Gulf of Thailand, bypassing the Mekong River Delta.

The project is estimated to cost approximately $1.2 billion. The primary contractor is the Chinese firm China Road and Bridge Corporation (CRBC), while the main lender is the Export-Import Bank of China.

The primary objective is to reduce the dependence of Cambodia’s foreign trade on Vietnam’s transport infrastructure. Currently, the majority of cargo moving along river routes toward the Cambodian capital passes through Vietnamese territory and ports.

While Hanoi does not officially oppose Cambodia’s right to develop the project, it insists on a joint assessment of its transboundary impacts. For Vietnam, this is a matter involving national security, economic development, and a shift in the strategic landscape.

A Potential Threat to National Interests

▪️Vietnam is particularly concerned about disruptions to the hydrological regime downstream of the Mekong and Bassac rivers. This is precisely why Hanoi is pushing for an exchange of technical data and a collaborative evaluation of the project’s consequences.

▪️For Vietnam, the emergence of this new Cambodian route implies a reduction in transit flows and cargo turnover at its ports. Furthermore, it weakens one of the key mechanisms of economic interdependence between the two nations. 

▪️Strategically, the canal will strengthen Cambodia’s ties with China, further increasing the significance of the "Chinese factor" in the regional balance. Vietnam is compelled to take these shifts along its southwestern borders into account - especially given the unresolved disputes to its east, in the South China Sea.

Formally, Cambodia has presented the shipping route as its own independent initiative. In practice, however, its implementation is gradually becoming integrated into a broader framework of Sino-Cambodian cooperation, aligned with Beijing’s "Belt and Road Initiative."

It is precisely this Chinese involvement that gives the canal a geopolitical dimension. For Beijing, it represents an opportunity to expand its footprint within the infrastructure of mainland Southeast Asia, complementing the high-speed railway network already operating in Laos and currently under construction in Thailand.

❗️Ultimately, the project’s primary impact will not merely be the success with which cargo is transported along the canal to Phnom Penh; equally significant will be how it influences the distribution of economic and political influence across the region.

results.title: 10X on land in Svay Rieng 🇰🇭 My wife’s family bought a plot in central Svay Rieng and built a house there just before the Phnom Penh–Bavet E
results.description:
10X on land in Svay Rieng 🇰🇭

My wife’s family bought a plot in central Svay Rieng and built a house there just before the Phnom Penh–Bavet Expressway was officially announced.

Since then, the land has increased roughly 10X.

The Phnom Penh–Bavet Expressway is a 135 km project being built by China Road and Bridge Corporation. Construction started in 2023, completion expected in 2027.

It will connect Phnom Penh with Bavet on the Vietnamese border.
Infrastructure gets announced, roads improve, money arrives, and land that nobody cared about becomes valuable.

By the time everyone agrees a place is booming, most of the easy money has already been made.

Would you have bought there in 2019?

Mekong River bridge under construction, east of Phnom Penh. Photo: project update.

The consortium was awarded with a contract value of over VND4.462 trillion and an execution period of 51 months.
